review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — group.test.ts covers every listed helper: pacerAt switching inclusively at atSec, pacerPhase across two out-of-order switches, pacerValue -1/+1, pacerCue in/out, all liveRead states with strict quarter boundaries and -33/-34 depth, formatLag/formatDepth signs, describeGroupAverage null and number, describePacer with zero and one switch.
- A2: met — format-dates uses 'en-GB' and local-time constructors. coaching-calendar covers isOpen for all five statuses, the three new dueText branches, timeAgo's five ranges, dayKey for Date and ISO, and lastDays (count, order, noon, ends today, month crossing).
- A3: met — rangeLabel listed range and fallback; inPeriod offsets 0 and 1 with both boundaries; periodStats best/weakest/openCount/rateOutside/perWeek (hand-checked: exhale timing mean 6, 7 sessions over 14 days = 3.5); bucketAverage/bucketRate null and 1-decimal, with paced and null rates ignored; daysAgoText, legacyBand at all four values, isLegacyScores for all three cases.
- A4: met — slug cases match the card. downloadText runs without jsdom using stubGlobal/spyOn and fake timers; it checks href, download, one click, removal, default and passed Blob types, and revocation only after timers run. Stubs and timers are restored in afterEach.
- A5: unverified — The diff adds only the six new test files, with no source or existing-test changes, comments or suppressions. No test, lint or typecheck output under TZ=UTC or Pacific/Auckland was provided.

<details><summary>3 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- formatLag(-0.04) pins behaviour the card lists as odd `src/lib/domain/group.test.ts:110` — Drop line 110 and mention the mismatch in the PR body.
- Exact en-GB strings depend on the ICU version `src/lib/domain/format-dates.test.ts:26` — Optionally loosen to /^Sun,? 8 Nov 2026$/ (and similarly on lines 16 and 10), or accept the pin as describing today's runtime.
- ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn> may not accept the narrowed spy under strict typecheck `src/lib/download.test.ts:26` — Type the variables as MockInstance<typeof URL.createObjectURL> / MockInstance<typeof URL.revokeObjectURL>, or let them be inferred inside each test.

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: formatLag(-0.04) pins behaviour the card lists as odd
suggestions.detail: Out of scope asks for odd behaviour to be reported in the PR rather than asserted, and names the formatLag(-0.04) vs formatDepth(-0.4) sign mismatch. The ±0.0 s output is arguably the sensible half, and A1 only asks for +, − and ±, which lines 107-109 already cover. Even so, this line locks in one side of a known inconsistency, so a later fix would break it.
suggestions.repro: Change formatLag to keep the sign for small negatives, as formatDepth does; line 110 fails.
suggestions.fix: Drop line 110 and mention the mismatch in the PR body.

suggestions.title: Exact en-GB strings depend on the ICU version
suggestions.detail: Whether en-GB puts a comma after the weekday ('Sun, 8 Nov 2026' vs 'Sun 8 Nov 2026', and likewise for formatDay) has changed between ICU/CLDR releases. These exact toBe assertions match today's Node 22 output but could break on a Node upgrade without any source change.
suggestions.repro: Run the suite on a Node build with a different bundled ICU or small-icu.
suggestions.fix: Optionally loosen to /^Sun,? 8 Nov 2026$/ (and similarly on lines 16 and 10), or accept the pin as describing today's runtime.

suggestions.title: ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn> may not accept the narrowed spy under strict typecheck
suggestions.detail: vi.spyOn(URL, 'createObjectURL') returns a MockInstance typed to that method's signature. Assigning it to the generic ReturnType<typeof vi.spyOn> can fail assignability on some vitest versions. Typecheck output isn't in the proof, so this can't be confirmed from the diff.
suggestions.fix: Type the variables as MockInstance<typeof URL.createObjectURL> / MockInstance<typeof URL.revokeObjectURL>, or let them be inferred inside each test.
